result.instructions: Tools for Voodoo SMS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many SMS credits do I have left on my account today?"; "Show delivery reports for the texts I sent recently."; "Which phone numbers are currently on my opt-out blacklist?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Voodoo SMS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run voodoosms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run voodoosms_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run voodoosms_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. voodoosms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: voodoosms_get_credits
tools.title: Get credit balance
tools.description: Get the SMS credit balance of the account. One credit pays for one 160-character SMS part (153 characters per part in a long message). Voodoo SMS REST: GET /credits.

tools.name: voodoosms_list_delivery_reports
tools.title: List delivery reports
tools.description: List delivery reports of sent messages (message_id, sender_id, to, sent_at, delivered_at, price, status), optionally filtered. Use it to check whether a message was delivered. Dates accept a UNIX timestamp, ISO 8601 (2026-10-01T09:00:00+00:00) or plain English ('yesterday', '2 weeks'). Voodoo SMS REST: GET /report.

message_id.description: The messages[].id returned when the SMS was sent.

sender_id.description: The sender id the messages were sent with.

to.description: Only messages sent to this number (international format, e.g. 447700900123).

sent_at.description: Only messages sent at this date/time.

delivered_at.description: Only messages delivered at this date/time.

start.description: Start of the date range to filter on.

end.description: End of the date range to filter on.

limit.description: Number of reports to return (default 25, max 1000).

tools.name: voodoosms_list_scheduled_messages
tools.title: List scheduled messages
tools.description: List SMS that were scheduled through the send API and are still waiting to go out (messages scheduled in the portal's Web SMS are not shown). Voodoo SMS REST: GET /schedule.

tools.name: voodoosms_list_inbox
tools.title: List received SMS
tools.description: List SMS received on the account's Virtual Mobile Numbers (replies and keyword messages). Needs a purchased number; an empty inbox returns an empty result. Dates accept a UNIX timestamp, ISO 8601 or plain English. Voodoo SMS REST: GET /inbox.

keyword.description: The keyword (first word of the message).

start.description: Oldest date of the messages to return.

end.description: Newest date of the messages to return.

from.description: The number the message came from (international format).

to.description: The number the message was sent to: your virtual number (international format).

reference.description: The external_reference of the original outgoing message.

sort.description: Sort by id, ASC or DESC (default DESC).

skip.description: Where to start the returned results (default 0).

limit.description: Number of messages to return (default 25, max 1000).

tools.name: voodoosms_list_numbers
tools.title: List virtual mobile numbers
tools.description: List the Virtual Mobile Numbers (VMNs) the account has purchased, used to receive SMS. Returns an empty result if there are none. Voodoo SMS REST: GET /numbers.

tools.name: voodoosms_list_contact_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List the account's contact lists (id, name, status, size, created/updated times) without their contacts. Returns an empty result if there are none. Voodoo SMS REST: GET /contacts.

skip.description: Where to start the returned results (default 0).

limit.description: Number of lists to return (default 100, max 5000).

tools.name: voodoosms_get_contact_list
tools.title: Get contacts in a list
tools.description: Get one contact list including its contacts (id, number, status, dynamic_data, created_at). Voodoo SMS REST: GET /contacts?contact_list_id=.

contact_list_id.description: The contact list id (id from list_contact_lists).

skip.description: Where to start the returned results (default 0).

limit.description: Number of contacts to return (default 100, max 5000).

tools.name: voodoosms_list_blacklist
tools.title: List blacklisted numbers
tools.description: List the numbers on the account's opt-out blacklist (no SMS is ever sent to them), or look up one number (`{empty: true}` means it is not on the list). Returns an empty result when the blacklist is empty. Voodoo SMS REST: GET /blacklist.

number.description: Look up a single number (international format, e.g. 447700900123).

start.description: Oldest date a number was added.

end.description: Newest date a number was added.

sort.description: Sort by id, ASC or DESC (default DESC).

skip.description: Where to start the returned results (default 0).

limit.description: Number of entries to return (default 25, max 1000).

tools.name: voodoosms_send_sms
tools.title: Send an SMS to one recipient
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS A REAL SMS to ONE recipient and USES THE ACCOUNT'S CREDITS (1 credit per message part, charged whether or not it is delivered; it cannot be undone). `sandbox` is required: true validates and prices the message without sending or charging, false sends it for real. Optional `schedule` queues it for later (cancel with cancel_scheduled_message). Do not retry after an error or timeout without checking list_delivery_reports / list_scheduled_messages, or the recipient may get it twice. One recipient per call; there is no bulk or list send. Voodoo SMS REST: POST /sendsms.

to.description: ONE recipient number: international format with the country code and no leading 0 (447700900123), or a national number if country_code is given.

from.description: Sender id shown to the recipient: 4 to 11 letters/digits or a number of up to 15 digits.

msg.description: The message text. 160 characters per part (153 in a long message), 70 (67) if it has emoji or other non-GSM characters; maximum 918 (402 with Unicode).

country_code.description: Country calling code of the recipient (e.g. 44), when `to` has no country code.

schedule.description: Send later: a UNIX timestamp, ISO 8601 (2026-12-25T09:00:00+00:00) or plain English ('2 weeks'). Must be in the future.

external_reference.description: Your own reference for this SMS (e.g. an order number); shown in reports.

sandbox.description: REQUIRED. true = validate and price the message only: nothing is sent and no credits are used. false = really send the SMS and use credits. Use true first unless the user clearly asked to send now.

annotations.title: Send an SMS to one recipient

tools.name: voodoosms_cancel_scheduled_message
tools.title: Cancel a scheduled SMS
tools.description: WRITE: cancels one SMS that was scheduled through the send API, so it will not be sent. A message that has already gone out cannot be cancelled. Whether credits are refunded for a cancelled message is not documented by the vendor. Voodoo SMS REST: DELETE /schedule/{id}.

id.description: The scheduled message id (id from list_scheduled_messages).

tools.name: voodoosms_add_to_blacklist
tools.title: Add a number to the blacklist
tools.description: WRITE: adds one number to the account's opt-out blacklist; from then on no SMS is sent to it (sends to it fail with error 20). Use it for a recipient who asked to stop. This tool cannot remove a number again. Voodoo SMS REST: POST /blacklist.

number.description: Phone number in international format with the country code and no leading 0, e.g. 447700900123.

annotations.title: Add a number to the blacklist

tools.name: voodoosms_create_contact_list
tools.title: Create a contact list
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new contact list with up to 500 contacts (the list name must be unique, at most 32 characters). It does not send anything. Voodoo SMS REST: POST /contacts.

name.description: Unique list name, at most 32 characters.

country.description: Default country calling code for the list (default 44).

number.description: Phone number in international format with the country code and no leading 0, e.g. 447700900123.

dynamic_data.description: Custom fields for this contact as {name: value}, at most 7 (usable in messages as {name}).

contacts.description: Contacts to put in the list: [{number, dynamic_data?}].

tools.name: voodoosms_update_contact_list
tools.title: Rename a contact list or add contacts
tools.description: WRITE: renames a contact list and/or adds up to 500 contacts to it (existing contacts are not removed). Adding dynamic data needs a list created as dynamic. It does not send anything. Voodoo SMS REST: PUT /contacts/{contact_list_id}.

contact_list_id.description: The contact list id (id from list_contact_lists).

name.description: New list name, at most 32 characters.

number.description: Phone number in international format with the country code and no leading 0, e.g. 447700900123.

dynamic_data.description: Custom fields for this contact as {name: value}, at most 7 (usable in messages as {name}).

annotations.title: Rename a contact list or add contacts
